entries.description: Pi5 E2E audit identified resource and security hardening gaps: SSE currently runs globally and should be dashboard-only with adaptive polling by active clients; add baseline security headers; harden systemd unit and sudo scope; split SSE/non-SSE write timeout behavior; encrypt notification secrets and backup artifacts; and add trusted-proxy IP handling plus DB indexes for alert/action/session hot paths.
entries.resolution: Resolved end-to-end on 2026-02-24: dashboard-scoped SSE, split write timeout behavior, backup/notification encryption, systemd+sandbox hardening, CI security gate, and root-owned `ultron-helper` IPC boundary replacing direct privileged execution from web process.

entries.description: Production SSH audit on 192.168.1.29 shows repeated template runtime failures on hardware page: `Failed to execute template hardware.html: template: hardware-form.html:3:52: executing \"partials/hardware-form.html\" at <.CSRFToken>: can't evaluate field CSRFToken in type server.hardwarePageData`. This causes hardware UI rendering failures and repeated sudo/pironman calls in logs.
entries.resolution: Resolved by aligning hardware view-model/template contract and restoring CSRF token propagation in hardware partial rendering.

entries.description: Root requirement for backup subsystem: it must be fully parameterizable from Settings as a first-class module (enabled flag, interval, retention count, local path, destination mode, encryption on/off, key reference, upload timeout/size). Current implementation is partially configurable; full operational control and security posture require complete settings-driven configuration with live apply and audited changes.
entries.resolution: Resolved by extending settings/config model and scheduler runtime to include schedule mode (`interval|daily|weekly|biweekly`), schedule hour/minute, encryption toggle + key reference, upload timeout, and max upload size with live apply.

entries.description: Production-readiness execution completed on Pi host 192.168.1.29: base performance and backup-restore integrity passed, auth/CSRF baseline passed, but browser security headers and least-privilege host hardening remain open. Supply-chain CVE verification could not be completed due environment limits (no govulncheck/network access) and must run in CI-connected security stage.
entries.resolution: Resolved on 2026-02-24: browser hardening baseline and supply-chain gate (`govulncheck`) added, host hardening applied, and least-privilege closure completed with dedicated helper-service architecture for privileged operations.

entries.description: E2E UX/UI audit of Ultron identified a solid functional base but non-premium visual execution. Main gaps: low visual hierarchy in dashboard, flat cards/surfaces, weak chart readability (minimal sparkline without depth/context), duplicated heading signals (header + page title), high cognitive load in Settings on mobile, and limited brand expression from default typography/system token contrast. Recommendation: move to a tactical premium visual system with atmospheric layered backgrounds, stronger panel depth, expressive but controlled typography, clear component hierarchy, richer data visualization (area + grid + value chips), and mobile-first sectioning/accordion patterns for long forms.
